preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(S) <= 10**6 for S in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip()])
preconditions.description: Each test case string S has length between 1 and 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for S in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip()] for c in S)
preconditions.description: Each character in S is a lowercase English letter.

preconditions.expression: int(stdin.splitlines()[0].strip()) == T and T >= 1 and T <= 10**4
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 10^4) representing the number of test cases.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one integer per test case.

postconditions.expression: all(output in ['-1'] or (output.isdigit() and 0 < int(output) <= len(S)) for S, output in zip([line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip()], stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either -1 (no valid P exists) or a positive integer representing the length of the longest valid P (1 ≤ length ≤ |S|).

postconditions.expression: all((output == '-1') == (not any(len(P) > 0 and P in S and not any(P[:i] in S[:i] for i in range(1, len(P)+1)) and not any(P[-i:] in S[-i:] for i in range(1, len(P)+1)) for P in [S[i:j] for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i+1, len(S)+1)])) for S, output in zip([line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip()], stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: If output is -1, no valid P exists for S. Otherwise, the output is the maximum length of a non-empty substring P of S such that no non-empty prefix of P is a prefix of S and no non-empty suffix of P is a suffix of S.
